facts.fact: 叙述者 Beau 到 the second Saturday in October 为止，已了解到关于 Harvest Festival 的 three things。
facts.anchor: By the second Saturday in October, I had learned three things about the Harvest Festival.

facts.fact: 自 last weekend 以来又有人在树上多挂了 another hundred feet 的橙色灯串，Beau 怀疑是 Rosie 干的。
facts.anchor: another hundred feet of orange lights through the trees since last weekend

facts.fact: Carson 对 Beau 说她 since six 就已经在集市，Beau 回称这是 poor planning。
Rosie 倒数后 Beau 和 Carson 一起推南瓜，但南瓜只走了 six feet 就急右转、越过干草捆滚到 Darlene 的折叠桌下。
facts.anchor: Our pumpkin made it six feet before taking a hard right

facts.fact: Beau 亲吻 Carson 的头顶，并承认自 opening weekend 起就知道自己爱她。
facts.anchor: I had known I loved her since opening weekend.

facts.fact: 一晚 Beau 和 Carson 为了吃意大利菜开了 forty minutes 的车，因为 Carson 坚持说 Willow Creek 唯一的意大利餐厅 committing crimes against pasta。
facts.anchor: driven forty minutes for Italian food

facts.fact: Halloween 落在 a Saturday，这是 officially the last festival day，大家都高兴这个月终于结束。
篝火旁 Beau 向 Carson 表白说已经 loved you for weeks 且她不必回应，Carson 回答 I love you, too 完成互诉。
